thread:
nora: hey all, first week q — need to flip a feature flag in staging to validate a model change. i don't have admin toggle rights for flags. who do i request temporary access from?

devops-oncall: welcome nora! :wave: for short-lived toggles we usually give a 4-8 hour `ff-admin` session via just-in-time access. open the JIT form: https://redwood.internal/jit-access and set duration. include the flag name + sprint ticket.

nora: thanks. flag is `models.v2_rollout` under project `realtime-search`. i tried the JIT form but it errors: "no matching role for your account". not sure which group to pick.

people-ops-bot: New JIT request attempted by nora — missing group: `console-operators`. Please request manual approval or ping a team admin.

tom: @nora i can approve manually. quick check: do you need service account credentials too for your e2e runs, or just console toggle?

nora: both ideally. e2e uses the service account to call the staging inference endpoint and assert latencies. if possible a key with a 6h TTL.

micaela: adding context — people-ops should auto-add new hires to `console-operators` after day 1 but sometimes provisioning lags. i'll add you now.

micaela: done. you should be in the group in ~3 minutes. try the JIT form again.

nora: form accepted this time, but it asked me to add an approval note. what's the recommended phrasing?

tom: short and specific: "Temporary ff-admin for models.v2_rollout validation per ENG-5123. Duration: 6h. Reviewer: tom."

nora: requested JIT with that note and requested 6h. @tom can you approve?

tom: approved. :white_check_mark: toggle window opens at 14:00 UTC.

devops-oncall: creating short-lived service account key for nora: `sa-nora-e2e` with roles: `inference.invoker`, `logging.writer`. Will set TTL=6h. Posting vault path when done.

devops-oncall: vault secret created at `secret/data/onboard/nora/sa-key`. Rotate policy applied.

nora: got the key, thanks. one last question — who owns the feature flag definitions? i want to add a description and experiment link so others know what it's for.

micaela: flag ownership lives in the flag metadata repo. PRs to `infra/feature-flags` with the flag id and owner alias. tag `@platform-flag-owners` for review. if it's infra-owned, ping me and i'll shepherd.

nora: perfect, will open a tiny PR after validating. cheers everyone :rocket:

people-ops-bot: Access changes: group `console-operators` membership added for nora by micaela.

devops-oncall: follow-up note: remember to disable the JIT session when done or it auto-expires. logs will show who toggled the flag.

nora: will do. thanks again for the quick help!
